leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom React hook that manages role-based access control permissions
Initialize state variables to store user roles and permissions within the hook
Implement permission-checking logic that validates user actions against assigned roles
Configure the hook to return permission status and control functions for UI components
Integrate the RBAC hook into functional components to conditionally render UI elements
Manipulate component behavior based on dynamic permission changes
Apply the permission hook across multiple components to demonstrate reusability
